comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Kallang MRT about 550 m, Mountbatten MRT about 820 m; closer than 259 of 662 similar developments (the same as 13). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 1,070 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 130 m), more than 513 of 662 similar developments (the same as 79); nearest hawker centre Blk 17 Upper Boon Keng Market And Food Centre about 710 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 700 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 17 Upper Boon Keng Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 800 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,510 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,530 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,630 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,960 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 212 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 230 new sales and 628 resales (858 purchases); new sales were 26.8% of these purchases. Subsales (51) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 970 m; Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,600 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 628 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 192 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 628 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 777 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19.2%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
